about: The test set for the rule in lib/recipe/cone-fit.js (docs/adr/0022), from the research report 'Chemistry against the stated cone', section 4, with 12 Glazy 'Production' glazes per band picked at random (seed 20261019). Run: node scripts/cone-fit-check.mjs.

Glazy rows: data from Glazy (https://glazy.org), whose public data is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/; https://github.com/derekphilipau/glazy-data). Each row keeps the recipe's id, name, author as Glazy gives it, cone, atmospheres, material names (no amounts) and the unity formula computed from Glazy's percent analysis of 31 May 2026 (glazy_20260531.yaml.gz). This file, and only this file, is shared under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Digitalfire rows: Digitalfire's recipes are All Rights Reserved, so only the code, name, cone and link are kept. Katz rows: the recipe is in Ceramics Monthly and is cited only. To include them, pass a file of their lines entered by hand: node scripts/cone-fit-check.mjs --lines <file>.
'expect' is the report's proposed result: none (no note), cooler, hotter or skip; 'random' marks a random row and its band. A note on a recipe whose cone its author states counts as a false note.
